channel.description: Latest articles from The Asian Age (asianage.com)

item.title: AA Edit | Indian IT Must Adapt To AI
item.description: The new AI tool — Anthropic’s Claude Cowork — is positioned as a more autonomous workplace agent that can plan and execute tasks across common knowledge-work flows, not merely answer prompts

item.title: K.C. Singh | Trade Deal Reality Check: A Multi-alliance Strategy
item.description: Describing his Indian interlocutor as “my greatest friend and a powerful and respected leader” in his own country, Mr Trump attributed the trade deal to the “friendship and respect” the two leaders shared

item.title: OF CABBAGES AND KINGS | When ‘Free Speech’ Is No Longer ‘Free’… And The Rising Peril Of ‘Deplatforming’ | Farrukh Dhondy
item.description: France, and now the UK, allege that X is guilty of the violation of security and the promotion of Holocaust-denying pro-Nazi propaganda

item.title: Shobhaa De | The General In His Literary Labyrinth... So, What Now?
item.description: Rahul was also accused of “defying the Chair’’. It didn’t stop there. Subsequently, eight Opposition MPs, including seven from the Congress, were suspended from the Lok Sabha for the remainder of the Budget Session: it was the first such suspension of MPs in the 18th Lok Sabha

item.title: AA Edit | RBI Neutral Amid Uncertainty
item.description: The Central bank expects GDP growth for 2025-26 to be at 7.4 per cent, driven by private consumption, fixed investment and the service sector. The revival of the manufacturing sector’s growth is visible even as construction and services remain resilient

item.title: AA Edit | All Leaders Need To Shun Hate, Put The Nation First
item.description: The frequent, perhaps even continuous, disruption of the Lower House since the discussion began on the Budget and then the trade deal with the United States and the motion of thanks to the President’s address in which the issue of a yet-to-be published in India memoir of an Army chief cropped up, is owed more to the hatred existing among those who run the government and those who are politically opposed to them

item.title: Deepa Anappara: I Reconstruct Marginalised Voices Through My Fiction
item.description: The winner of the 2021 Edgar Award for Best Novel for her debut work on colonialism, comedians and the role of research in her books

item.title: Book Review | Lifestyle Journalism Becomes Political
item.description: Vasudev is not trying to write a polemic or a theory-heavy intervention. The politics of the book emerges through tireless accumulation, instead of simplistic accusation

item.title: Book Review | Rolling Vista of ‘Real India’
item.description: The Social Life of Indian Trains is a slim volume — more like an expanded essay than a fully-fledged, book-length work

item.title: Book Review | Reverse-Engineered ‘State-of-the-Nation’ Stories
item.description: This is not Anita Nair at her best, unfortunately. The stories are not tight, there’s a lot of meandering, which can make the reading tedious
